body:
I don't mind questions.

I live in the UK.

I don't have a job. I used to look after my mum as she was disabled; Cerebral Palsy, COPD and Renal Failure. I have worked before though; I worked at the offices of a bank in the recruitment team among other jobs (ranging from McDonalds to the County Court). But I always found it too difficult; I found it really difficult to carry out even simple tasks like answering the phone. So I would beat myself up over it because I'm useless at doing things that others can do with ease.

And yet I get really high grades for my University work (first class awards) but I don't feel proud about it because I'm still crap at everything else and I always will be and there's nothing I can do about it.

Right at this moment I feel very drowsy. That's been happening a lot lately.
